text:
incident-bot: automated page fired -> rule: latency.p99 > 1100ms for 5m across prod-eu (route: inference-hotpath)
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-98321 — P99 latency SLO burn (link: https://pd.example/PD-98321)
Maya Patel: acked on PD, taking lead. I'm on call.
Jon Chen: acked. joining. what's the customer impact here? any errors or just slow responses?
Maya Patel: from alert graph: p50 ~ 120ms, p95 ~ 480ms, p99 spiking to 1.2-1.6s over last 7m. error rate stable. some EU business customers reporting timeouts on long prompts.
Liam O'Connor: seeing KV cache eviction rate jump on eu-west-1 sidecar nodes. possible cache thrash after recent routing change.
Sasha Ivanov: paging cadence shows autoscaler thrashing too — pods flapping between 60-80% CPU. could be small-batch bursts plus hotkey traffic.
Jon Chen: can we quick reduce batch window or temporarily cap concurrent requests for that pool?
Maya Patel: good idea. I'll try reducing batch_window from 25ms -> 10ms on eu-west-hotpath to prioritize latency. applying change now.
Ops Bot: command executed: set-config --pool eu-west-hotpath --batch_window 10ms
Maya Patel: pushed config, flux accepted. watching metrics.
Liam O'Connor: also enabling hotkey mitigation: route known hotkey prefixes to shard-2 fallback pool (lower throughput but lower tail latency). doing that now.
Jon Chen: running a sanity check: `kubectl get pods -n inference eu-west-hotpath` — several pods in CrashLoopBackOff? logs show OOMKilled on a couple.
Sasha Ivanov: OOMs line up with big model ancestry warmups — looks like a recent model variant rollout to eu-west that has higher mem profile.
Maya Patel: rollback model variant to previous stable on eu-west-hotpath. `runtimectl rollback --pool eu-west-hotpath --model my-model:v42 -> v41`
Ops Bot: rollback initiated for eu-west-hotpath: v42 -> v41
Jon Chen: rolling back complete on 4/6 nodes, remaining 2 still draining.
Maya Patel: p99 dropped to ~720ms within 90s of rollback and config changes. still above SLO but trending down.
Liam O'Connor: KV eviction rate also decreasing after rollback. I think the combination of higher-mem model + routing caused cache pressure.
Sasha Ivanov: customers: three EU tenants reported 504s; ticketing shows retries but no data loss. flagged support SLA.
Maya Patel: posting customer impact to PD and support. PD incident notes updated.
Jon Chen: we should scale up reserved pool temporarily to absorb burst while autoscaler stabilizes. Maya, can you request a soft-capacity bump?
Maya Patel: requesting +2 GPUs to eu-west dedicated pool; submitted request to infra-ops, ETA ~ 4m.
Ops Bot: capacity request acknowledged by infra-ops queue (#IR-4721).
Liam O'Connor: while we wait, enabling short-circuit fallback: if latency > 800ms then proxy to smaller quantized model (v41-quant). low-quality but keeps latency.
Maya Patel: enabled fallback policy. adding a short notice to PD.
Jon Chen: good. p99 now ~430-600ms after fallback and rollback. autoscaler stabilized, pod restarts stopped.
Sasha Ivanov: leaving a note: root cause likely rollout of v42 (higher memory & different kernel path) combined with routing change that concentrated hotkeys into a smaller shard causing KV cache thrash and OOMs.
Maya Patel: running post-incident checks: collecting traces, tail logs, and the rollout change set. will open postmortem doc.
Jon Chen: handoff: I'm out in 30m, Maya will keep ownership. Maya, can you confirm next steps for follow-up and customer comms?
Maya Patel: yes. follow-up: 1) revert rollout gating for v42 until perf tests passed, 2) add additional autoscaler hysteresis on eu-west, 3) add a canary rule that watches KV eviction rate during rollouts, 4) notify affected customers with incident summary.
Sasha Ivanov: adding action: extend observability retention for the window 5m before to 15m after incident for deeper traces.
Maya Patel: noted. handing off to next oncall: @Jon Chen (will stay for 30m) then @Liam O'Connor. closing PD alert once stable for 15m.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-98321 status: acknowledged -> monitoring. responders: Maya Patel, Jon Chen, Liam O'Connor.
Maya Patel: marking this thread. final p99 at last check 520ms, CPU and eviction metrics nominal. leaving incident in monitoring for 15m before close.
Jon Chen: thanks team. :thumbsup:
Liam O'Connor: nice quick rollback/patch. will draft RCA notes.
incident-bot: automated follow-up scheduled: create-postmortem PD-98321 in 24h, remind assignees: Maya Patel, Liam O'Connor, Sasha Ivanov
Maya Patel: closing thread here, moving to postmortem doc. good job everyone. :tada:
